content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

When comparing options for selling digital products, it's crucial to consider what each platform actually offers. Traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal may seem convenient but come with significant restrictions, especially for creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. On the other hand, blockchain-based solutions, paired with infrastructure from Cloudflare, provide a sovereign and unrestricted way to sell digital products globally, without the need for intermediaries.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Creators in restricted countries face significant challenges when trying to sell digital products internationally. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal often have stringent requirements and may not support local currencies, making it difficult for creators to receive payments. In contrast, blockchain-based payment solutions, such as those integrated with NOWPayments, can handle transactions in multiple cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10, bypassing traditional banking restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed, fees, and real costs are critical factors when choosing a platform for selling digital products. Traditional platforms often charge hefty fees, and payment processing can be slow. In contrast, blockchain-based solutions offer faster payment processing times and significantly lower fees. For example, USDT on Tron offers settlement in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10, making it an attractive option for creators looking to minimize costs and maximize efficiency.
Blockchain-based payments offer faster payment processing times and significantly lower fees than traditional platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership, automation, and delivery are essential aspects of selling digital products online. With traditional platforms, creators often have limited control over their products and customer data. In contrast, sovereign digital commerce stacks, built using Cloudflare infrastructure and blockchain-based payments, provide creators with full ownership and control over their products, customer data, and delivery processes, enabling them to automate and optimize their sales funnels efficiently.

Choosing the right architecture for selling digital products depends on the creator's specific situation and needs. For those in restricted countries or looking for a sovereign solution, blockchain-based payments paired with Cloudflare infrastructure offer a robust and unrestricted way to sell digital products globally.
